Genset at ~1542 rpm (posterior p=0.82, display confirms), but 1× at 25.7 Hz exceeds the 15 Hz video Nyquist and scale is uncalibrated — so several faults are non-evaluable. Reporting each finding with its evidence before deciding on optimisation.

title: Speed and kinematics confirmed - diesel genset at 1542 rpm
summary: Muse Spark model: genset, synchronous, 4-stroke, display_rpm 1542 rpm. Bayesian speed posterior MAP 1542.39 rpm, 68% CI 1540.02-1544.76 rpm, p_map 0.816; next mode 770.93 rpm (1/2x) p=0.100, 2x mode p=0.050. Independent display check: 1542 rpm, display_error 0.025%. Peaks explained 14/18, prior scale-invariant flat in log f. Tracked speed 1544.28 rpm / 25.738 Hz is consistent. Speed is not ambiguous (p_map >0.8) and display corroborates, so no alternative kinematic test is warranted.

title: Capture limits: 1x above Nyquist and uncalibrated amplitude - imbalance/misalignment not evaluable
summary: fps 30.0, Nyquist 15.0 Hz, near_nyquist_warning true, while 1x is ~25.7 Hz; orders_vel_mm_s_now 1x/2x/3x are all 0.0, so video cannot resolve shaft orders. scale_calibrated is false and overall iso_zone is null: amplitudes are relative only, do NOT use absolute mm/s or ISO 20816 zones for severity. Fault posterior evaluable:false with p unchanged from prior for imbalance p=0.15, misalignment p=0.10, flow p=0.10, cavitation p=0.08, bearing p=0.08, rotor_bar p=0.05 - these are neither ruled in nor out. Required better capture: tach-referenced contact accelerometers (or video fps well above 51.4 Hz, preferably much higher) sampled well above 1x with cross-coupling phase for misalignment, radial 1x for imbalance, and bearing-frequency coverage.

title: Structural modes identified; resonance probability low at current speed
summary: FDD structural modes: 2.109 Hz (zeta null, sv_ratio 3.29), 2.8125 Hz (zeta 0.085, sv_ratio 2.50), 3.75 Hz (zeta 0.043, sv_ratio 4.92), 7.031 Hz (zeta 0.042, sv_ratio 9.39), all with left/right shape phases within ~13 deg of in-phase; residual peak 2.344 +/-0.234 Hz, zeta null. Campbell criticals: none listed. Resonance fault p=0.030 vs prior 0.12, evidence forcing-to-mode separation 2.656 at -6.5 dB, so no order crossing a natural frequency in operation is evidenced. Confidence limited: zeta missing for 2.109 and 2.344 Hz modes and no damping error bars are provided.

title: No evidence of cylinder-to-cylinder combustion imbalance
summary: Combustion fault p=0.016, p_range 0.015-0.042, vs prior 0.10; evidence 1/2-order/firing-order ratio 0.02 at -8.7 dB. Audio corroborates dominant steady diesel combustion roar / cylinder firing throughout, exhaust/turbo pulsation consistent with loaded diesel at governed speed, no distinct metallic knock, rubbing_or_impacts false. Practitioner half-order/firing signature is absent.

title: No evidence of mechanical looseness
summary: Looseness fault p=0.016, p_range 0.012-0.016, vs prior 0.08; evidence only 2 shaft harmonics 1-10x above 10 dB at -7.2 dB - the many-harmonics looseness rule is not met. Audio shows only low-level enclosure/sheet-metal and hose rattle, no distinct metallic knock, rubbing_or_impacts false.

title: Cavitation / flow not supported and not evaluable on this genset
summary: Cavitation index 0.066, hf_energy_fraction 0.014, hf_kurtosis 0.051, and audio cavitation_like false - no high-frequency impulsive cavitation signature. However fault posterior cavitation and flow are evaluable:false, p=0.08 and p=0.10 unchanged from prior, and the identified machine class is genset, not centrifugal pump. Do not diagnose pump cavitation from the index alone on this asset.

title: Optimisation withheld - fixed-speed synchronous genset, shaft-order evidence missing
summary: No setpoint proposal made: kinematics model is genset, synchronous true, audio speed_changing steady at governed speed (1542 rpm display, posterior MAP 1542.39 rpm), so speed is locked to electrical output frequency and is not a free optimisation variable. In addition 1x 25.7 Hz is above the 15.0 Hz video Nyquist and scale is uncalibrated, so a digital-twin speed move cannot be validated from this capture. Before any intervention, recapture with tach-referenced contact accelerometers sampled well above 1x (and bearing frequencies), with radial and cross-coupling phase channels and a calibrated amplitude scale.

text:
## Assessment

**Asset identification**
- Machine class: diesel **genset**, synchronous, 4-stroke.
- Speed posterior MAP: **1542.4 rpm**, 68% CI **1540.0–1544.8 rpm**, probability **0.816**.
- Display speed: **1542 rpm**, independently agreeing within **0.025%**.
- Tracked speed: **25.738 Hz / 1544.3 rpm**.
- The speed posterior explains **14 of 18 peaks**. No alternative kinematic hypothesis is justified because \(p_{\mathrm{map}}>0.8\) and the display corroborates the result.

**Evaluated fault evidence**
- **Resonance:** posterior probability **0.030**, down from 0.12 prior; forcing-to-mode separation **2.656**, evidence **−6.5 dB**. No Campbell criticals were identified. Structural modes were found at **2.109, 2.8125, 3.75 and 7.031 Hz**, with damping ratios **0.085, 0.043 and 0.042** where available. Damping was unavailable for the 2.109 Hz mode, so this conclusion is not high-precision.
- **Cylinder combustion imbalance:** probability **0.016** versus 0.10 prior; half-order/firing-order ratio **0.02**, evidence **−8.7 dB**. No supporting combustion-imbalance signature.
- **Mechanical looseness:** probability **0.016** versus 0.08 prior; only **2 shaft harmonics** exceeded 10 dB. The many-harmonics looseness pattern is absent.
- **Cavitation-related audio/high-frequency evidence:** cavitation index **0.066**, high-frequency energy fraction **0.014**, high-frequency kurtosis **0.051**, and no cavitation-like audio. This does not establish pump cavitation, particularly because the asset is a genset.

## Important evidence limitation

The capture cannot evaluate several major faults:

- Video rate is **30 fps**, giving a **15.0 Hz Nyquist frequency**.
- Shaft frequency is approximately **25.7 Hz**, so 1× is above Nyquist.
- Reported 1×, 2× and 3× order amplitudes are all **0.0**.
- Amplitude scale is **uncalibrated**, and the overall ISO zone is **null**. Therefore no ISO 20816 zone or absolute mm/s severity is reported; only frequencies, ratios, phases and relative patterns are usable.

Consequently, these hypotheses remain **not evaluable**, with posterior probabilities unchanged from their priors: imbalance **0.15**, misalignment **0.10**, flow excitation **0.10**, cavitation **0.08**, bearing defect **0.08**, and rotor-bar/electrical asymmetry **0.05**. They have neither been confirmed nor excluded.

A suitable recapture would use calibrated, tach-referenced contact accelerometers with bandwidth covering shaft orders, harmonics and bearing-defect frequencies, plus radial measurements and phase across couplings.

## Optimisation decision

**No setpoint change is proposed.** This is a synchronous, governed-speed genset operating steadily at approximately **1542 rpm**; shaft speed is tied to generator output frequency and is not an independently variable process setpoint in the available evidence. Running the speed optimiser or proposing a new speed would therefore be inappropriate and unsupported by the current capture.
